$comment: The workstation's MinIO (docker-compose.dev.yml), mirroring production's layout (DEPLOYMENT.md §2): each brand has a media key that writes only its own public bucket, and a masters key — the origin's reads and writes every master, the outlet's reads masters and writes only under print-files/. The synthetic brand's two storefronts play the two roles. Applied by `pnpm --filter @engine/media storage:policies`; staging and production get a plan of their own with the same policy documents (TASKS.md 41.2).
